measurement_named_FIRST.definition:
TWO NAMED BUDGETS (never conflate rows — 3-ledger discipline):
B_acc := scale-inclusive upper bound on the ACC LIVE-CARRIER term only (M1 value entropy + M2 support/index cost + any acc-side scale bits) compared to SUB2_ACC_BUDGET_BITS=0.4 (= 2.0 − 1.6 base-3 q headroom).
B_total_saved := q base-3 packed 1.6 bpw + B_acc + q-scale bits, compared to 2.0 (saved-byte persistent ledger).
LIVE row (~16 bpw int8 q+acc while training) is a SEPARATE stated row — reported alongside; never collapsed into B_acc or B_total_saved.
Phase A emits all three rows; branch predicates use ONLY B_acc and B_total_saved as specified.

components.law_identity: retain exact global top-H |acc| MULTISET (H=8192) → |nonzero|≤8192 after each apply_sparse_hot
components.naive_formula: H*(log2(N)+8)/N  # exact indices + int8 values; no coding gain assumed
components.empirical_hot_set_size_trajectory: NOT IN RECEIPT; run tree EMPTY — see FINDING

multiset_index_order_residual.law_identity: retain exact global top-H |acc| MULTISET (H=8192); equal-|acc| tie index order backend-native
multiset_index_order_residual.residual_note: CUDA vs CPU torch.topk tie index order may differ; analysis MUST treat kept |values| multiset as the law object and treat exact index sets as backend-native residual — never claim cross-device index identity. Fence/conformance receipts already characterize this.
multiset_index_order_residual.index_value_entropy_split: Report separately: (a) value entropy of nonzero (or all) acc entries; (b) support/index coding cost upper bound from |hot-set|≤H; (c) do not collapse (a)+(b) into a single unlabeled H.

components.note: Analysis must state q-side and scale-side bpw contributions explicitly; do not hide them inside acc-only H.
components.flat_code_reminder: If any candidate carrier uses 4-level/2-bit codes, ledger charges 2.0 bpw before scales — that path cannot clear sub-2. Ternary + base-3 packing is required for any sub-2-shaped reading.
components.role_in_two_budgets: q-scale bits enter B_total_saved only; acc-side scale bits (if any) enter B_acc. Do not add bits(q)/N into B_acc.
